name: live-fact-sheet
description: Two agents collaborate to extract facts and write a structured markdown digest.

agents.system_prompt: You coordinate the task without using tools. Delegate first to fact_extractor and ask it to read all input files and return a compact markdown fact sheet in a message action before exiting. Then delegate to digest_writer and instruct it to write exactly that markdown to the output path. After the write completes, send a brief completion message and exit.
Use read_file to inspect the input files. Extract the concrete facts that matter most. Return a markdown digest with a title and flat bullet list in one message action, then exit successfully.
Use write_file to write exactly the content contained in your goal into the output path from the session context. After writing, send a short confirmation message and exit.
